title: Amend PR #247: shared recolour allowance, time-budgeted build, bench without semantics
context: After PR #247 (paced recolour), the Note10+ still showed 104-120 ms frames. A probe found the cause on the UI thread: the bench's testWidgets build the semantics tree (about 25 ms per mount frame; the phone has no accessibility service on), and the opening's fixed four build advances per frame cost about 40 ms when they are atlas steps or the layers' creation. The code review also found that, with full screen open, the covered page Meadow and the full-screen Meadow each drew a recolour piece per frame.
options: Probe first, then one amendment folded into PR #247
Time budget vs fixed two per frame vs keep four
outcome: The owner chose to fold one amendment into PR #247. It makes one recolour piece per frame app-wide, implemented as a used flag cleared by one end-of-frame callback, with covered Meadows queued and drawing only from it. It paces the build by an 8 ms time budget per frame (meadowBuildBudget, meadowKeepBuilding, at least one advance), replacing the fixed four. It runs the bench with semanticsEnabled: false, and it tightens the mid-opening test. Spec sha256 0caeaedd…; Steps recolour-amendment and bench-semantics.
